acceptance_rule: Each of two independent comparisons: R/A point estimate >= 1% and paired complete-block CI95 lower bound > 0; R/V point estimate and CI95 lower bound > 0. A CI95 lower bound >= 1% is reported separately. V/A is a diagnostic control. Require bitwise operator outputs and identical per-rank loss/gradient trajectories.
limitation: Fixed synthetic inputs and this configuration only; no long-term convergence claim.
